scope: Studio/Director AI-dependent controls, private generation paths, advertised adjacent capabilities and deterministic paths that could be confused with AI.

classificationMeaning.DETERMINISTIC_REAL: Actual algorithm/render path; not model inference.
classificationMeaning.AI_REAL: Actual trained model implementation, with historical private evidence where present; not a PRO/production claim.
classificationMeaning.PROXY_ONLY: Claimed intelligent/generative behavior is approximated by nonmatching filtering/animation/UI.
classificationMeaning.PARTIAL: Real subset exists; broad capability/Studio lifecycle/integration incomplete.
classificationMeaning.MISSING_BACKEND: No matching executable model backend at audited baseline.

features.implementation: Shared 90k-clock command kernel, revision replay, review guards; FFmpeg final execution.
features.gap: A Director label does not establish scene perception.

features.feature: Director visual semantics and source selection
features.implementation: Private content-factory Qwen3-VL director/critic; general Studio source-shot analysis uses cuts and face observations.
features.gap: Private Qwen inference is real, but no universal scene-understanding service/continuous semantic coverage at baseline.

features.implementation: Contracts, source assertions and grounded private scene plans exist.
features.gap: Model assertions require verified artifacts and temporal coverage; whole-movie planning remains incomplete.

features.implementation: YuNet ONNX + optional MediaPipe; cascade fallback.
features.gap: Only faces; cannot substitute for arbitrary text-conditioned object detection.

features.gap: Sampled observations, not universal point/object correspondence or re-identification.

features.implementation: OpenCV/FFmpeg image differences and scene thresholds.
features.gap: Detects picture boundaries, not semantic scene identity.

features.implementation: No Grounding DINO production adapter at baseline.
features.gap: The new pinned adapter must produce real detections before model-output qualification.

features.implementation: Pinned SAM2.1 tiny private L40S masks; immutable mask PNG cache consumed by VFX compositor.
features.gap: Prior model path is per-feature/private worker, single subject, explicit cut prompts, no hair-matte guarantee.

features.implementation: SAM2 mask centroids drive source-bound callouts.
features.gap: Mask centroid is not a tracked physical point and confidence is not calibrated.

features.implementation: TAPNext++ absent at baseline; public checkpoint now locked separately.
features.gap: TAP adapter and qualification still required; do not silently substitute centroids for points.

features.implementation: Manual/keyframe/face-coordinate paths and tracked subject callout subset.
features.gap: No general arbitrary-object/planar tracking service across edits and cuts.

features.implementation: Analytic alpha masks and normal compositing.
features.gap: These shapes must never be called learned segmentation.

features.implementation: SAM mask occlusion + deterministic text placement.
features.gap: Segmentation quality/occlusion boundaries require actual frame review.

features.gap: Effects themselves are deterministic; broader modes are not generative editing.

features.implementation: Real SAM segmentation with small mask-derived 2.5D displacement.
features.gap: No dense/metric depth model, no disoccluded scene reconstruction.

features.feature: Dense or metric scene depth and true 3D-aware editing
features.implementation: No learned dense depth runtime/artifact contract at baseline.
features.gap: Future Depth Anything/metric depth integration needs its own contract and license review.

features.implementation: Mask-guided smoothing, color/skin heuristics, source-preserving filtering.
